title: fix(app-shell): a full-height console page gives the impersonation banner its height back
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuDJAbBe3iTrFcF7GZrucZ32)_

Fixes #37528

## What changes

- `ChromeBannerSlot` (`app-shell/src/layout/chromeBannerHost.tsx`): when the console's standing banners (impersonation, read rate, storage) are drawn **in place** above the routes, a `display: contents` wrapper measures them (`ResizeObserver` on each child, `MutationObserver` for banners that come and go) and publishes the summed height as `--os-chrome-banners` on the document root; cleared on unmount and while nothing is drawn. Drawn into an app layout's host (desktop, inside an app, objectstack#36112) nothing is published, as that host sits inside the content area.
- The console's full-height shells take the viewport less that property, through `CONSOLE_FULL_HEIGHT` (module-local constants, literal Tailwind classes): `AppShell` in `@object-ui/layout` (height, and a `min-h-` that tailwind-merge puts in place of the sidebar wrapper's own `min-h-svh`), `StudioDesignSurface`, `HomeLayout`, `AiChatPage`, the two organization layouts, the app-unavailable / no-app screens in `AppContent`, and `StudioRoute`'s access-required screen. The property is unset outside the console and on an ordinary session, so every class there computes to the plain viewport height.
- The banner keeps its place in flow (objectui#4467) and its `sticky`; nothing about where it is drawn changes.

## Why

While an administrator impersonates a user, the banner sat in flow above a shell that still took `100svh` / `100vh`, so the document was taller than the window by the banner's height: list footers and bulk action bars fell below the fold and the page grew a second scrollbar.

Measured on `main` (411646562) in a local console against `examples/app-crm` (`--fresh`), impersonating a seeded user, `document.documentElement.scrollHeight` against `innerHeight`:

| page | 1280×768 before | 1280×768 after | 390×844 before | 390×844 after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `/home` | 768 / 768 (redirects into the app) | 768 / 768 | 921 / 844 | 844 / 844 |
| an app list (`crm_lead`) | 768 / 768 (#36112 host) | 768 / 768 | 921 / 844 | 844 / 844 |
| `/studio` | 821 / 768 | 768 / 768 | 921 / 844 | 844 / 844 |

The first push fixed `/home` only: the sidebar wrapper's own `min-h-svh` and Studio's access-required screen still overflowed, which the second commit covers.

## Verification

- New `layout/__tests__/chromeBannerHost.bannerHeight-37528.test.tsx` (5 cases: in place publishes the summed height and clears on unmount; no banner publishes nothing; a resize and a banner going away republish; drawn into the host publishes nothing; every full-height class reads the property with a `0px` fallback). With `chromeBannerHost.tsx` restored from `main`, 3 of the 5 go red (the two "nothing published" cases are controls).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` over `packages/layout/`, `packages/app-shell/src/layout/`, `src/console/__tests__/`, `src/console/home`, `src/console/ai`, `src/console/organizations`, `src/views/studio-design`, the print stylesheet pin, `apps/console/src/components` and the boot-redirect pins: all green (3,325 + 3,862 tests). `ai-surface-unavailable` in `ConsoleShell` is deliberately left on `h-screen`: `bootRedirectCoverage.test.tsx` reads that class as the full-viewport cover.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/layout`: clean. `eslint` on the changed files: 0 errors.
- The full UI suite runs in this PR's CI.
- `overlap-check`: exit 0 (shares `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` with #37546 and `AiChatPage.tsx` with #37539, both merge cleanly).
